note: Curated from official sponsor pages only (GSA, NASA SEWP, NITAAC, CHESS, Navy, DISA, DIA, DLA). Fields marked null could not be verified on an official page and are deliberately omitted from display. Confirm every fee and ordering rule against the linked ordering guide before relying on it.

vehicles.name: GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS)
vehicles.fee: 0.75% Industrial Funding Fee, embedded in Schedule prices
vehicles.scope: Millions of commercial products and services across 10 large categories (IT, professional services, facilities, industrial, security, transportation).
vehicles.status: Active, evergreen — continuous open solicitation.

vehicles.name: NASA SEWP V
vehicles.fee: 0.34% surcharge, embedded in prices
vehicles.scope: IT/communications/AV products and product-based services for all federal agencies.
vehicles.status: Active — NASA intends to extend through 1/31/2027 to bridge to SEWP VI.

vehicles.name: NASA SEWP VI
vehicles.scope: Successor to SEWP V with expanded IT-services scope (ICT/AV solutions).
vehicles.status: In transition — awards in process; anticipated period 11/1/2026–10/31/2036; not yet open for ordering.

vehicles.name: GSA Alliant 2
vehicles.fee: 0.75% contract access fee on each task order
vehicles.scope: Full-range IT services and solutions worldwide, including AI, DLT, RPA. $75B ceiling.
vehicles.status: Active — ordering period ends 6/30/2028; successor Alliant 3 now open.

vehicles.name: GSA Alliant 3
vehicles.fee: 0.75% contract access fee (per-order cap TBD by program office)
vehicles.scope: Next-generation enterprise IT services GWAC for civilian and defense agencies.
vehicles.status: OPEN — notice to proceed 3/10/2026; master contract runs to 3/9/2031 + one 5-yr option.

vehicles.name: GSA 8(a) STARS III
vehicles.fee: 0.75% contract access fee
vehicles.scope: IT services from 8(a) firms, including emerging tech. Directed (sole-source) 8(a) orders permitted below the competitive threshold. $50B ceiling.
vehicles.status: Active — ordering period runs to 7/1/2029.

vehicles.name: GSA VETS 2
vehicles.fee: 0.75% contract access fee
vehicles.scope: IT services exclusively from service-disabled veteran-owned small businesses. $6.1B ceiling.
vehicles.status: Active — ordering period runs to 2/22/2028.

vehicles.name: GSA Polaris
vehicles.fee: Contract access fee generally 0.75% (per GSA Small Business GWAC guide)
vehicles.scope: Customized IT services from small business pools (SB, WOSB, HUBZone, SDVOSB). No ceiling; on-ramps planned.
vehicles.status: NEWLY OPEN — all four pools open for ordering as of mid-2026; more awards expected through FY2026.

vehicles.name: GSA OASIS+
vehicles.fee: 0.15% flat contract access fee on each invoice
vehicles.scope: Complex non-IT professional services across 13 domains (management/advisory, technical & engineering, R&D, environmental, logistics, financial, human capital…).
vehicles.status: Active and open for ordering — 10-yr families; Phase II rolling awards underway.

vehicles.name: GSA OASIS / OASIS SB (legacy)
vehicles.scope: Predecessor to OASIS+ for complex professional services.
vehicles.status: ORDERING CLOSED — SB/8(a) ended 12/19/2024, Unrestricted ended 3/1/2025. New work goes to OASIS+.

vehicles.name: GSA HCaTS / HCaTS SB
vehicles.fee: 0.75% contract access fee (separate CLIN)
vehicles.scope: Human capital management and training services.
vehicles.status: SUNSETTING — 8(a) ordering ended 12/21/2025; Unrestricted ends 9/25/2026; SB ends 11/9/2026. Follow-on work → OASIS+ or MAS.

vehicles.name: GSA Enterprise Infrastructure Solutions (EIS)
vehicles.scope: Enterprise telecommunications and networking — voice, data, internet, wireless, managed network, security.
vehicles.status: Active — all task orders must end by 7/30/2032; GSA researching the successor.

vehicles.name: GSA 2GIT BPAs
vehicles.fee: MAS 0.75% IFF applies via Schedule pricing
vehicles.scope: IT hardware, COTS software, and related services from 70+ SCRM-vetted BPA holders. MANDATORY for Air Force IT-product buys.
vehicles.status: Active but ENDING — ordering period closes 9/30/2026; follow-on not yet announced.

vehicles.name: GSA ASTRO
vehicles.fee: No contract access fee — negotiated GSA assisted-acquisition fee per order
vehicles.scope: Services for manned/unmanned systems, robotics, and platforms — operations, maintenance, integration, R&D.
vehicles.status: Active. Task orders are signed only by GSA AAS contracting officers — requiring activities go through GSA AAS.

vehicles.name: NITAAC CIO-SP3 / CIO-SP3 SB
vehicles.fee: NCAF 0.65% (SB: 0.55%), capped at $150K per order period
vehicles.scope: IT services across 10 task areas including health and biomedical IT.
vehicles.status: SUNSETTING — final day to award new orders 10/29/2026; orders awarded on/after 6/8/2026 end by 12/31/2028. HHS is retiring all NITAAC GWACs; work transitions to GSA vehicles.

vehicles.name: NITAAC CIO-CS
vehicles.fee: NCAF fixed 0.35%
vehicles.scope: IT commodities and commodity-enabling services — hardware, software, cloud, mobility.
vehicles.status: SUNSETTING — extended through 10/29/2026 (final ordering day); same NITAAC-wide retirement.

vehicles.name: NITAAC CIO-SP4
vehicles.scope: Planned successor to CIO-SP3 — never stood up.
vehicles.status: CANCELLED (Feb 2026) after protest years; HHS retiring all NITAAC GWACs, requirements transition to GSA.

vehicles.name: Army CHESS ITES-3S
vehicles.fee: No fee
vehicles.scope: IT services — cybersecurity, cloud, network/systems O&M, enterprise integration. Army's preferred source for IT services; open to DoD and other agencies via CHESS IT e-mart.
vehicles.status: Active but late-life — options run to ~9/25/2027; successor is Army MAPS (pre-award; the planned ITES-4S was scrapped and folded into MAPS).

vehicles.name: Army CHESS ITES-SW2
vehicles.fee: No fee
vehicles.scope: COTS software licenses and maintenance in 14 categories. MANDATORY source for Army COTS software; usable by DoD and other agencies. $13B ceiling.
vehicles.status: Active — 5-yr option runs to 8/30/2030 (confirm option status on chess.army.mil).

vehicles.name: Army CHESS ITES-4H
vehicles.fee: No fee
vehicles.scope: Enterprise IT hardware — servers, storage, networking, imaging. Army's mandatory source for commercial IT hardware. $10B / 10 years, 49 awardees.
vehicles.status: Active — awarded September 2025; runs to ~2035 with option.

vehicles.name: Navy SeaPort-NxG
vehicles.fee: No fee
vehicles.scope: Professional support services — 23 functional areas of engineering and program-management support. Navy/Marine Corps commands only.
vehicles.status: Active — ordering period runs to 1/1/2029; rolling admissions add primes.

vehicles.name: DISA ENCORE III
vehicles.scope: Full range of IT services for DoD, other agencies, and the IC. $17.5B ceiling. Orders coordinate through DISA DITCO.
vehicles.status: Late-life — large task orders being recompeted in 2026; end date and successor not published (verify with DITCO before planning new orders).

vehicles.name: DIA SITE III
vehicles.scope: IT services for DIA and NGA — app development, cybersecurity, enterprise computing. $12.6B, 144 awardees. Not open government-wide.
vehicles.status: Active — option period runs to 3/1/2031.

vehicles.name: Air Force EITaaS Wave 1 BPA
vehicles.scope: Enterprise IT service delivery for ~800K DAF users (service desk, EITSM, network). DAF-internal — not orderable by other agencies.
vehicles.status: Active — work expected complete by August 2032.

vehicles.name: Air Force NETCENTS-2
vehicles.scope: Former AF IT products/services vehicles.
vehicles.status: EXPIRED — AF IT-product buying is now mandatory via GSA 2GIT; enterprise IT services via EITaaS.

vehicles.name: DLA Tailored Logistics — Special Operational Equipment
vehicles.fee: DLA cost-recovery embedded in delivered price
vehicles.scope: Tactical gear, diving/lifesaving, survival equipment and incidental services. DLA competes your funded requirement among TLS prime vendors and places the order.
vehicles.status: Active program of record.

vehicles.name: DLA Tailored Logistics — Fire & Emergency Services Equipment
vehicles.fee: DLA cost-recovery embedded in delivered price
vehicles.scope: Firefighting and emergency services equipment, including wildland fire. DLA competes and awards among FESE primes.
vehicles.status: Active.

vehicles.name: DLA Maintenance, Repair & Operations (MRO)
vehicles.fee: DLA cost-recovery embedded in delivered price
vehicles.scope: Facilities MRO supplies by region — DLA competes your requirement among regional primes.
vehicles.status: Active.

vehicles.name: VA T4NG2 (Transformation Twenty-One Total Technology NG2)
vehicles.scope: Full-range IT and health-IT services — $60.7B, 10 years, 33 primes (~17 SDVOSB). Ordering runs through VA TAC; OMB Tier 2 multi-agency designation.
vehicles.status: OPEN — cleared for task orders after the final protests were denied (Mar 2026); legacy T4NG winding down.

vehicles.name: VA Federal Supply Schedules (healthcare)
vehicles.fee: IFF built into schedule prices
vehicles.scope: Nine healthcare schedules — pharmaceuticals (statutory Big-4 pricing), medical/dental/lab equipment and supplies, patient mobility, healthcare staffing. ~1,600 contracts, >$25B annual sales; open to all federal agencies.
vehicles.status: Active, continuous open season.

vehicles.name: Army RS3 (Responsive Strategic Sourcing for Services)
vehicles.fee: 0.25% task-order admin fee for outside contracting offices
vehicles.scope: C4ISR-related services worldwide — engineering, RDT&E, logistics, acquisition support, training. $37.4B ceiling; open to DoD and federal agencies with in-scope requirements.
vehicles.status: Active but sunsetting — ordering period runs into 2027; successor is Army MAPS (pre-award).

vehicles.name: Army MAPS (Marketplace for the Acquisition of Professional Services)
vehicles.scope: $50B, 10-yr consolidated successor to RS3 and ITES-3S (the scrapped ITES-4S/ACCESS plans folded in) — the future of Army services buying.
vehicles.status: PRE-AWARD — final RFP released Apr 2026, proposals were due May 2026; watch for awards.

vehicles.name: DoD Enterprise Software Initiative (ESI)
vehicles.scope: Enterprise software agreements/BPAs for major COTS publishers (Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, VMware…). DFARS 208.74 makes checking ESI MANDATORY before DoD buys commercial software.
vehicles.status: Active.

vehicles.name: DLA ECAT (medical Electronic Catalog)
vehicles.fee: DLA cost-recovery built into catalog prices
vehicles.scope: ~1.3M medical, dental, and lab items ordered through the ECAT web platform over DLA contracts — DoD plus other federal agencies (VA is a major customer).
vehicles.status: Active (25+ years running, ~$1B/yr).

vehicles.name: GSA COMSATCOM (MAS SIN 517410)
vehicles.fee: 0.75% (SIN ordering; legacy custom-solutions IDIQs carried 2.00%)
vehicles.scope: Commercial satellite communications — transponded capacity, subscription/managed services, satphones, terminals; any commercial band.
vehicles.status: Active as a MAS SIN (the legacy CS2/CS3 custom IDIQs have wound down).

vehicles.name: DISA JWCC (Joint Warfighting Cloud Capability)
vehicles.scope: $9B multi-vendor cloud IDIQ (AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle) for DoD — orders flow through DISA DITCO via the DAPPS portal.
vehicles.status: Active — ordering through June 2028; JWCC Next solicitation planned FY26 with awards targeted early 2027.

vehicles.name: DoD IAC MAC (Information Analysis Centers)
vehicles.scope: $48B IDIQ for DoD scientific/technical R&D analysis across 3 pools, with fully-assisted requirements development.
vehicles.status: Active — ordering period through 9/29/2027.

vehicles.name: Air Force EWAAC (Enterprise Wide Agile Acquisition Contract)
vehicles.scope: $46B multi-award IDIQ for agile weapons-system development and acquisition; repeated on-ramps have grown the vendor pool. Verify ordering rules with AFLCMC/EB.
vehicles.status: Active — ordering options run to 9/9/2031.

vehicles.name: GSA OneGov agreements
vehicles.scope: Government-wide OEM-level agreements and discounts negotiated directly with major software makers (Google, Adobe, Salesforce, Microsoft…), generally delivered through MAS. Where cancelled agency vehicles (DHS FirstSource III, PACTS III) point their workload.
vehicles.status: Active and expanding (2025–26 GSA strategy).

vehicles.name: DISA DEOS (Defense Enterprise Office Solutions)
vehicles.scope: GSA-Schedule BPA for DoD-wide Microsoft 365 collaboration (~$4.4B). Confirm current status with DISA before planning orders.
vehicles.status: Active per last official reporting — verify current status.

vehicles.name: DHS FirstSource II / III
vehicles.scope: Former DHS small-business IT products vehicles.
vehicles.status: CLOSED — FirstSource II expired; FirstSource III cancelled in 2025 (awards terminated) with work redirected to GSA (MAS/OneGov).

vehicles.name: DHS PACTS III
vehicles.scope: Planned DHS small-business professional-services vehicle.
vehicles.status: CANCELLED before award (June 2025) under procurement consolidation — DHS directs requirements to GSA OASIS+ and MAS.

vehicles.name: DLA Wildland Fire Protection Program
vehicles.fee: DLA cost-recovery embedded in price
vehicles.scope: 250+ NWCG/NFES wildland fire supplies and equipment via FedMall — federal, state, and local fire agencies (state/local pre-pay by card).
vehicles.status: Active at DLA since 2014 (transferred from GSA; no GSA wildland fire program remains).
